method.method: Use Japanese-style consonant-vowel patter for Spanish. Practise vowels attached to consonants rather than isolated vowels.
method.reason: User reports this practice helped their own Spanish sound natural. Treat as the teaching inspiration, not a controlled efficacy claim.
